tool_action.private_thought: Owe $750 to p2, short $509. Three light-blue houses sell for $75, leaving me $316 — still $434 short, and nothing else is mortgageable while buildings remain. I have to sell first so the engine will then let me mortgage the light blues. Even after that, mortgage values are only Oriental $50 + Vermont $50 + Connecticut $60 = $160, for a ceiling of $476 against $750. This sale is forced and insufficient; bankruptcy follows once the houses are gone. Do not try to keep a house — even sale is the only legal path and it still cannot clear the rent. Never trade. Game is lost after the mortgages.
